# rwx_group (Resource)

Manages RWX group metadata. Permissions, memberships, and relationships are managed separately and are not changed by importing or updating this resource. Renaming a group preserves its ID. RWX rejects deletion of protected groups, including system groups and groups whose deletion would remove required access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_group" "deployers" {
  name        = "Deployers"
  description = "Team responsible for deployments"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the group. Omit to clear the description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable ID of the group. Use this ID to import an existing group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_group.deployers 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
